en-US.shortDescription: Spoiler-safe recaps of any TV show, up to the episode you've reached.
en-US.fullDescription: Back from a break and can't remember what happened? Tell Catch Me Up the show and how far you got, and get a short spoken recap of the story so far, without a single spoiler from later episodes. Ask for a recap of a whole range of seasons, or a quick "previously on" for the episode you're about to watch.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Catch Me Up to recap Severance through season 1.
Alexa, ask Catch Me Up what happened in The Bear up to season 2 episode 4.
Alexa, ask Catch Me Up for a previously on before season 2 episode 5 of Succession.
